doc: A slot read only when the attribute's own slot is absent (databricks.fbl#configuration, the pipeline rule's schema with secondary: {key: target}; FBL 0.10, section 5.2; spec 066, User Story 2, scenario 7). The pipeline legacy has target and no schema, so its schema is the value of target; a set writes schema and removes target. Its body is written here.

steps.doc: Setting the schema writes schema, where the attribute order puts it, after catalog, and removes target in the same edit (secondary, section 5.2).

expectFiles.../pipelines.yml:
resources:
  pipelines:
    legacy:
      name: Legacy target
      catalog: main
      schema: bronze
    both:
      name: Both written
      schema: gold
      target: silver

steps.doc: Undo removes schema and puts target back.

expectFiles.../pipelines.yml:
resources:
  pipelines:
    legacy:
      name: Legacy target
      catalog: main
      target: silver
    both:
      name: Both written
      schema: gold
      target: silver
